name: Linear
description: Linear's own remote MCP server. The agent reads issues and projects, searches, and writes comments or status changes with your account's permissions. Sign-in is a normal Linear OAuth flow, so access can be revoked from Linear at any time.

probe.note: GET without a token answers 401 with resource_metadata at mcp.linear.app; the protected-resource document lists authorization server https://mcp.linear.app with scopes read, write.
